name: Hay bale
description: A rectangular straw hay bale bound with two twine bands, about 0.9 m long, 0.5 m wide and 0.45 m high, golden but slightly desaturated, with loose wisps sticking out of its edges and a few strands on the ground around it. A variant stacks two bales side by side with a third across them on top, about 0.9 m high.
